releaseNotes:
What changed:
- Short dramas play like a reel on a phone: swipe up for the next drama, down for the
  one before it, and left for the synopsis and every episode. Brightness and volume
  still live on the left and right edges.
- Fixed the sub or dub you picked being thrown away when an anime episode ended and the
  next one started — it used to fall back to the English dub.
- The loading page now lets you pick another server instead of waiting for the current
  one to give up. Movies and series only.
- Fixed brightness and volume swipes stopping halfway on anything with subtitles.

Already on 1.53.0 or newer? This installs itself as usual.

On 1.52.1 or older? 1.53.0 changed the app's identity, so Android will not install this
over your copy and the in-app update stops with "The downloaded update belongs to a
different app." Uninstall GIZTV once, then install this build from the release page.
Watch history does not carry across that one reinstall. Updates after it are automatic.
